title: Winter Wine Weekend, Winter Wine Festival (Red Hill Showgrounds)
summary: Saturday's headline event. 38 Peninsula wineries and 150 wines under the Red Hill Showgrounds pavilions, Riedel glass included, masterclass upgrade available, designated driver tickets cheap.
priceRange: Ticketed; General Admission, Masterclass and Designated Driver tiers
suitableFor: Adults 18+ (children welcome under supervision); wine enthusiasts; tourists
accessibilityNotes: Pavilion accessible; children welcome; playground at Red Hill Reserve nearby
weatherDependency: Pavilion is indoor, Saturday weather largely irrelevant; surrounding winery events may be outdoor
nearbyAttractions: Red Hill Brewery Secret Stash (nearby weekend); Stonier Pies & Pinot; Paringa Estate
suggestedItineraryPairing: Book accommodation in Red Hill/Merricks; combine Sat festival with Sun/Mon cellar door lunches at Paringa or Ten Minutes by Tractor
internalNotes: Possible duplicate of winter-wine-weekend-june, flag for editor review. Winery count refreshed from Humanitix ticket page on 2026-06-01.
editorVerdict: Saturday is the headline. 38 wineries, 150 wines, one room, one glass. The most efficient afternoon in Peninsula wine.
editorNote:
Saturday 6 June, 11am to 4pm, in the Pavilions at Red Hill Showgrounds. Your ticket covers a Riedel tasting glass, the room, and all 150 wines across 38 wineries. The masterclass upgrade gets you into a hosted flight with Ed Merrison. The designated driver ticket exists, use it.

For first-time Peninsula visitors this is the single best afternoon to learn the region. For locals it's the only day you can compare Stonier, Polperro, Paringa, Montalto and Crittenden inside an hour.

Do the festival Saturday, dinner at Many Little or Merricks General Store, cellar door trail Sunday with a long lunch booked. The Red Hill Brewery Secret Stash weekend lands a fortnight later if you want to come back.
